title: Survey-grade volume calculations over a region of interest — compute_survey_volumes
text: list class "dronebio_survey_volume": method Method used. cut_volume_m3 Volume base (m^3). fill_volume_m3 Volume base (m^3, positive). net_volume_m3 cut - fill (m^3). surface_area_planar_m2 Projected (planimetric) area valid cells inside ROI. surface_area_draped_m2 3D surface area via cell-wise slope tangent; NA terra::terrain() computed (e.g. ROI < 3x3 cells). perimeter_m Planimetric polygon perimeter. cell_count Number valid top-cells inside ROI. cell_area_m2 Grid cell area, m^2. top_z_summary Named vector min/median/mean/max top surface inside ROI. base_z_summary base surface. height_summary (top - base). base_reference_text Human-readable description base method.

title: Survey-grade volume calculations over a region of interest — compute_survey_volumes
text: volume math standard raster integral $$V = \sum_i (z_i^{top} - z_i^{base}) \cdot A_{cell}$$ clipped positive (cut) negative (fill) contributions, sum runs every cell top whose centre lies inside ROI polygon. base surface built grid clipped top, cut fill computed cell--cell resampling artefact top base. Base-reference methods: "dtm" Use separate DTM (bare-earth model) base. correct method canopy biomass DTM available: cut volume reduces \(\int (DSM - DTM) dA\), .e. canopy height model integrated ROI. "min_z" Constant plane minimum top-surface value inside ROI. classic stockpile method separate bare-earth model exists. "mean_z" Constant plane mean top-surface value. "ground_quantile" Constant plane low quantile top surface (default 5th percentile). robust proxy ground DTM "min_z" sensitive single dark pixel. "user_plane" Constant plane user-supplied base_z. "perimeter_tin" Triangulated irregular network built top-surface values sampled ROI's perimeter vertices. industry standard stockpile surveys (used Pix4D Mapper, Bentley ContextCapture, Trimble Business Center): perimeter rests surveyed "natural ground line", Delaunay triangulation interpolates linearly vertices, volume integral top - TIN inside ROI. Requires optional interp package. planimetric 3D draped surface areas reported. draped area sum cell areas inflated secant local slope, \(A_{drape} = \sum_i A_{cell} \cdot \sec(\theta_i)\), standard formula photogrammetric reporting.

text: Sample project first-run experience. New dronebio_sample_project() run_drone_biomass_studio(sample = TRUE) seed clickable ODM-shaped project bundled fixtures app works immediately without flight data. CHM volume measurement GIS map. New “Measure volume (CHM)” tool: click polygon vertices basemap summary table reports CHM area, mean max height, surface volume - Pix4D / Metashape volumetric measurement parity item. GeoJSON map annotations layer. New annotation mode GIS Workspace sidebar: pin named notes coordinates persist annotations.geojson project directory; reload later session via file picker. Multi-ROI comparison table. Save current measurement polygon named ROI, compute side--side NDVI / NDRE / EVI / SAVI / biomass-proxy means CHM mean / max / volume saved ROIs. Bundled HTML report + one-click render. New render_dronebio_report() exported function “Render HTML report” button Exports panel. RMarkdown template inst/report/biomass_report.Rmd includes ODM inventory, reflectance summary, per-index histograms, CHM, optional field-based biomass model. Ground / vegetation classification. New classify_ground_vegetation() rule-based 5-class NDVI + CHM classification, classify_ground_csf() bridging lidR::classify_ground() Cloth Simulation Filter. Time-series registry Shiny panel. Register multiple flights site CSV registry, plot NDVI / biomass / CHM means across dates new “Time Series” nav panel. New exported helpers: default_flight_registry(), register_flight(), list_flights(), flight_time_series(), flight_ndvi_mean(), flight_biomass_proxy_mean(), flight_chm_mean().

title: DroneBioR 0.3.0
text: COG-style raster tiling. New tile_raster_on_map() private helper app uses leafem::addGeotiff() leafem package installed, process-scoped temp-file cache keyed raster fingerprint. Pan/zoom large orthomosaics now incremental rather re-rendering downsampled image interaction. Falls back cleanly existing addRasterImage() path leafem available. Async workflow execution. run_dronebio_workflow() now runs background R session via promises::future_promise() future promises installed. Shiny UI stays responsive workflow writes products disk; falls back synchronous execution otherwise. Toast-based error UI. New exported with_error_toast() helper catches errors inside Shiny reactives renders notifications instead default red traceback. Applied six event-driven reactives (mosaic, gis_stack, point_cloud, extracted_field, model, workflow). validate() / req() inline messages still work helper re-throws shiny.silent.error. Reactive caching. bindCache() applied mosaic, gis_stack, point_cloud hillshade reactives re-loading inputs -memory hit rather re-read.
